notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Hellkite Charger
description:
Activate Fire Nation Palace's second ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, giving Hellkite Charger firebending 4 until end of turn.
Declare Hellkite Charger as an attacker, triggering it and its firebending ability twice.
Resolve both Hellkite Charger firebending triggers, adding eight {R}.
Resolve the first Hellkite Charger trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

description:
Declare Aethergeode Miner and Lightning Runner as attackers, triggering their abilities twice each.
Resolve both Aethergeode Miner triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Resolve the first Lightning Runner trigger, causing you to get {E}{E} and choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second Lightning Runner trigger, causing you to get {E}{E} and pay eight {E} to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve a Altaïr trigger, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Resolve the other Altaïr trigger, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Put either Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering the other Éomer token, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three creatures in your party.
Burakos does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Burakos.
description:
Declare Burakos as an attacker.
Burakos triggers twice, creating at least six Treasure artifact tokens and causing the defending opponent to lose 6 life.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three creatures in your party.
Burakos does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Burakos.
description:
Declare Burakos as an attacker.
Najeela and Burakos trigger twice.
Resolve both Najeela triggers, creating two 1/1 Warrior creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Burakos triggers, creating at least six Treasure artifact tokens and causing the defending opponent to lose at least 6 life.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

notablePrerequisites:
You have a full party.
Burakos does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Burakos and Hellkite Charger.
description:
Declare Burakos and Hellkite Charger as attackers, triggering their abilities twice.
Resolve both Burakos triggers, creating eight Treasure artifact tokens and causing the defending opponent to lose 8 life.
Activate seven Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the first Hellkite Charger trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

notablePrerequisites:
Delina does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Delina and Lightning Runner.
description:
Declare Delina and Lightning Runner as attackers, triggering their abilities twice each.
Resolve a Delina trigger, creating at least one token copy of Aethertorch Renegade that enters the battlefield tapped and attacking.
The Aethertorch Renegade token(s) enters the battlefield, causing you to get at least {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Resolve the second Delina trigger, creating at least one token copy of any creature you control that enters the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Resolve the first Lightning Runner trigger, causing you to get {E}{E} and choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second Lightning Runner trigger, causing you to get {E}{E} and pay eight {E} to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, each creature token created by Delina triggers, exiling themselves.
Repeat each combat phase.

description:

The Multiform Wonder token(s) enters the battlefield, causing you to get at least {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat from step 2 for the remaining Delina trigger.
Resolve the first Lightning Runner trigger, causing you to get {E}{E} and choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second Lightning Runner trigger, causing you to get {E}{E} and pay eight {E} to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, each creature token created by Delina triggers, exiling themselves.
Repeat each combat phase.
Once you have infinite {E}, you can target different creatures with Delina's triggers.
